player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ GameOfPureStrategy akansi mu.
- Wokura kɔpem 13, A-K; biara betumi ayɛ adwuma kakraa.
- Ɛkɔsi biara, wɔbɛda kɔpem bi adi. Di kɔpem kakraa biako kwa wɔkyerɛw biribi a wɔde kɔpem token bi te sɛ '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Kɔpem kɛseɛ na ɛdi nkunim (plus carry-over). Tie no bɛtwe nkunim no kɔ pot mu maa ɛkɔsi a ɛdi hɔ.
- Ɔha kɛseɛ a wodi nkunim wɔ ɛkɔsi 13 akyi na ɔdi nkunim.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɛsɛ sɛ dwumadi no yɛ krataa a wɔaka ho asɛm ABIƐSA bi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
